summary: The vLLM wheel bundle can also be built for linux/arm64 (DGX Spark, GB10), for the DGX Spark image
compatibility: No change to linux/amd64 wheels, locks or build caches; LIL_WHEEL_PLATFORM=linux/arm64 selects the arm64 build.
details: The arm64 build uses the arm64 twin of NVIDIA PyTorch 26.08 (same torch, CUDA 13.4.1 and packages) and aarch64 build-tool hashes, under QEMU on the amd64 wheel builder.
